A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the reaction of thiazolopyrimidines with hydrazine hydrate and NaBH4 in ethanol in the presence of catalytic amount of V2O 5 is a very convenient and effective way for the preparation of the corresponding triazolopyrimidine.
the reduction of the thiazolopyrimidine ring by NaBH4 in combination with V2O5 in ethanol is an efficient method for the synthesis of triazolopyrimidine.
the rearrangement of thiazolopyrimidines into the corresponding triazolopyrimidinones is induced by the reduction of C=N bonds.

a simple reduction of a thiazolo[2,3-a] pyrimidine can be used as a convenient method to prepare the corresponding triazolo[2,4-a] pyrimidines.
